cutoff.hint: Where the sound starts to weaken: a low-pass filter takes away what is above it, as a wall or water does; a high-pass filter what is below it, as a small speaker does.
decay.hint: How long the sound rings on in the space: a fraction of a second for a room, several seconds for a cave or a hall.
density.hint: How thick the reflections are: less is drier and grainier.
diffusion.hint: How much the reflections blend: less lets single reflections through.
damping.hint: How much the walls soak up the highs: soft walls damp more.
wet.hint: How much of the effect is mixed in; the sound itself is heard as before.
delay.hint: When the first repeat comes back, up to 0.207 seconds.
feedback.hint: How much quieter each repeat is: closer to 1 gives more repeats.
edge.hint: How hard the sound is driven: more is rougher.
tone.hint: Above what frequency the distorted sound is damped.
mix.hint: 1 plays only the distorted sound, 0 only the original.
